# Location States & Failure Handling Checklist: Altitude Display

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for location states and failure handling are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable (standard PR-review depth)
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every location state in the data model (waiting, available, altitudeUnavailable, permissionDenied, servicesDisabled, reducedAccuracy)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is the "reducedAccuracy" state covered by a functional requirement, not only by an edge case? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the first-launch permission prompt, including what the screen shows while the prompt is open? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a user who permanently denies permission, including how Settings is reached? [Gap, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK005 Is behavior specified when permission or location services change while the app is running or after resume? [Coverage, Gap, data-model.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the exact message content (or intent) defined for each failure state rather than just "understandable"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK007 Is "waiting for GPS" distinguished from "altitude unavailable" with clear entry conditions for each? [Clarity, Spec §US3, FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Is "update" in the 30-second staleness rule defined (any position update vs. one containing altitude)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 Is the rounding rule for displayed feet and the accuracy value specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Is it defined when a reading counts as having a "usable" altitude (e.g., invalid or non-finite values)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, data-model.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the staleness requirement (30 s) and the SC-001 time-to-first-altitude (10 s) avoid conflicting expectations for the waiting state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, SC-001]
- [x] CHK012 Are the status lists consistent across spec, data model, and the service contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, data-model.md, contracts/altitude-service.md]
- [x] CHK013 Is the "while-in-use only" permission requirement consistent with the foreground-only assumption and resume re-check? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can SC-004 ("100% of failure states show a message") be objectively verified against a defined list of states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK015 Is SC-003 (accuracy versus a reference point) measurable given the phone's reported accuracy varies per reading? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Does each user-story-3 acceptance scenario map to a specific functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §US3, FR-008]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are recovery requirements defined for moving from each failure state back to a live reading (e.g., user enables location, fix acquired)? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a fix that arrives with altitude but no vertical accuracy? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for rapid flapping between states so the UI does not flicker? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK020 Is behavior specified when the splash screen ends before a first status is known? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Non-Functional & Privacy

- [x] CHK021 Are accessibility requirements (e.g., readable text size, screen-reader labels) specified for the altitude and failure messages? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [x] CHK022 Are privacy requirements explicit about diagnostic logging of location values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 Is the assumption that the phone reports meters and a vertical accuracy value documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Is the dependency on the device location service's update frequency documented, since it affects the 30-second rule? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
